recipe_version.title: German Beef Rouladen with Mustard Gravy and Boiled Potatoes
recipe_version.description: Thin slices of top round spread with sharp mustard and rolled around bacon, onion, and dill pickle, browned and braised until fork-tender, then served in a dark, mustard-tinged pan gravy with parsley boiled potatoes and a cucumber-dill salad.

ingredients.name: beef top round sliced for rouladen
ingredients.display_name: thin-cut beef top round for rouladen

ingredients.name: bacon
ingredients.display_name: bacon strips whose label lists pork, salt, sugar, and curing agents only

ingredients.name: yellow onions
ingredients.note: 1 thinly sliced for filling, 1 chopped for gravy

ingredients.name: dill pickles
ingredients.display_name: dill pickle spears whose label lists cucumbers, vinegar, salt, dill, and garlic

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1/2 tsp beef, 1/2 tsp gravy, 1 1/2 tsp potatoes

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Slice one onion thinly for the filling and chop the other. Halve the pickle spears lengthwise. Chop the carrot and celery. Peel and halve the potatoes. Slice the cucumber very thin, chop the dill and parsley.

steps.title: Fill and roll
steps.body: Pound each beef slice between plastic wrap to an even 1/4 inch. Season with 1/2 tsp salt and the pepper, spread each with mustard, and lay on a bacon strip, some sliced onion, and a pickle strip at the short end. Roll up tightly, tucking in the sides, and tie with twine or secure with toothpicks.

steps.title: Brown the rolls
steps.body: Heat the oil in a 5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high and brown the rolls on all sides, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Build the braise
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium. Cook the chopped onion, carrot, and celery until soft and browned, about 6 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste for 1 minute. Add 3 cups water, the bay leaves, and 1/2 tsp salt, scraping up the browned bits, and return the rolls.

steps.title: Braise
steps.body: Bring to a simmer, cover, and braise over low until the rolls are fork-tender, about 1 1/2 hours, turning them once halfway.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes and make the salad
steps.body: For the last 25 minutes of the braise, put the potatoes in a 4-quart pot with 8 cups water and 1 1/2 tsp salt and boil until tender, about 18 minutes; drain and toss with half the parsley. Toss the cucumber with the vinegar, sugar, and dill (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.body: Lift out the rolls, remove the twine, and keep warm. Strain the braising liquid, pressing on the vegetables, and return it to the pot. Whisk the flour into 1/4 cup cold water, whisk it in, and simmer until thickened, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve the rouladen with the gravy spooned over, the parsley potatoes, and the cucumber salad, and scatter the remaining parsley.
